title: Chapter 666 - 666 Mecha Battle; Regret!
content:
Chapter 666 - 666 Mecha Battle; Regret!

Chapter 666 - 666 Mecha Battle; Regret!

666 Mecha Battle; Regret!

Li Dongqiang, Zhao Ting, and the others’ noise attracted the attention of many people.

They all looked over.

However, no one tried to stop anything from happening.

Instead, they all revealed an expression of watching a good show.

Zhao Ting’s cold eyes swept across Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Tian Zhiwu. Just as he was about to speak…

At this moment, a loud voice suddenly sounded.

“Members of Group 7 of the joint examination, gather here!”

When everyone heard this, they all looked in the direction of the voice.

There stood a middle-aged man with thick eyebrows and big eyes. He exuded a stern aura.

When many people saw him, they were surprised and started discussing.

“Captain Li Ke!”

“Heavens, our invigilator is actually Captain Li Ke!”

“He’s an S-class special ability user. Moreover, he’s at the top of the S-class!”

“Later, we must perform well. If Captain Li Ke takes a fancy to us, that’ll be a very good thing!”

“As expected, the joint examination is very important!”

…

As they spoke, they quickened their pace and approached Li Ke.

Zhao Ting glanced at Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Tian Zhiwu again. He said sternly, “See you on the field!”

Tian Zhiwu looked at his departing back and heaved a long sigh of relief. “Fortunately, he left…”

Then, he said to Lin Fan, Xia Xue, and Li Dongqiang, “This is just how Zhao Ting is. Actually, I could’ve just stepped aside just now. But thank you.”

“I was pushed too,” Li Dongqiang said. “It’s not too much to thank me a few times, right?”

“Huh?” Tian Zhiqu was stunned and said, “Thank… Thank you.”

Li Dongqiang pursed his lips and thought, ‘There’s only one gratitude token again.’

Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Tian Zhiwu followed the crowd to where Li Ke was.

Li Ke glanced at the bustling students and said loudly, “I think your teacher has already explained the contents of the competition. Mecha and the arena!

“You’ll be provided with standardized mechas by the World Alliance.

“The rules are simple. Fight!

“The mecha assessment time is two hours. All mechas have an energy core. Breaking an energy core will give you one point. Those who leave the assessment area will fail.

“If there are no more questions, everyone can collect your mechas and enter the building of Group 7 for the examination.”

As he spoke, Li Ke pointed at the mechas and the tall building beside him.

Some of the students from Jiangbei University started to whisper among themselves.

“I was wondering why the school suddenly built so many new buildings. So it’s for competitions.”

“There’s a thick layer of foam below the building, so I’m not worried about getting injured from falling.”

“Let’s go. Hurry up and get into the mechas.”

…

At this moment, Lin Fan, Xia Xue, Li Dongqiang, and Tian Zhiwu found their mechas.

All the mechas were red in color, with numbers written on their left arms and an eye-catching energy core at the bottom of their necks.

Lin Fan casually operated his mecha and started to compare.

This mecha’s operation and performance were similar to the school’s, so it could be considered somewhat handy.

Thousands of red mechas walked towardsthe tall building in batches, forming a scene of a future battlefield.

After everyone operated their mechas into the building, they first observed the environment and kept their distance from the people around them.

That was because everyone was an enemy now.

Anyone could suddenly attack them.

“The assessment begins!”

At this moment, a loud and clear voice sounded from the tall building.

At the same time, a projection of the time and the number of people appeared.

[Time: 119:59]

[Number of people: 1,000]

Almost as soon as the voice fell, a series of loud noises immediately sounded from the tall building.

The entire building shook.

[Time: 119:30]

[Number of people: 990]

In 30 seconds, the energy cores of ten people were directly shattered!

Chaos unfolded.

Suddenly, loud noises rang out throughout the entire building. Dust filled the air, and gravel flew everywhere.

The towering skyscraper looked as if it would collapse at any moment.

Lin Fan, who was standing in his mecha, did not care about the battle around him. He did not take the initiative to attack anyone.

In his eyes, these battles were like children fighting, and he was completely uninterested.

He went straight to a mecha near the corner.

When the mecha saw someone approaching, it immediately became alert.

“It’s me!” Lin Fan said.

The standard mecha was the initial data. It was not connected to other equipment.

Generally speaking, communication could only be made if both parties agreed.

Lin Fan’s voice appeared in Xia Xue’s mind.

Xia Xue looked at the left shoulder of Lin Fan’s mecha and quickly saw his number. She could not help but feel relieved.

At this moment, she received a communication request.

“Lin Fan, have you seen Li Dongqiang?”

After all, Li Dongqiang was their classmate.

There was strength in numbers, and it was always safer to be together.

“Li Dongqiang is in the east.”

Then, the two of them piloted their mecha and headed east.

At this moment, Li Dongqiang was holding his long knife high and slashing it at the energy core of the mecha in front of him. The mecha immediately lost its ability to move.

Li Dongqiang could not help but smile. He had scored!

In the next moment, his heart tightened, and he hurriedly turned around to escape.

He suddenly saw two mechas charging toward him.

Li Dongqiang felt that he had good strength.
